text:
maria: Heads-up: invoice INV-2026-0998 from Lusa Devs Lda includes 23% VAT but PO shows our EU VAT ID. Holding payment until we clarify.

leo: @sophie can you advise? Vendor says they're on 'regime simplificado'.

sophie: Short: reverse charge can apply for B2B cross-border services. We need VIES check + reissued invoice referencing reverse charge and our VAT ID. Regime simplificado doesn't automatically block reverse charge.

taxbot: invoice parsed | id: INV-2026-0998 | vendor VAT: PT123456780 | gross: EUR 4,620.00 | VAT: EUR 846.60 | received_ts: 2405678800

maria: Vendor replied: "We are regime simplificado (NIF PT123456780). Charged VAT per our accountant. Can reissue if needed." Attached PDF.

sophie: Action: run VIES (done) => PT123456780 valid. Ask vendor to reissue with line: "IVA - autoliquida\u00e7\u00e3o / reverse charge" and include our EU VAT ID EU987654321. Also confirm invoicing legal entity.

leo: They also asked for a W-9 because their parent is in the US. Reminder: W-9 only for US persons. If invoicing entity is Portuguese, we don't need W-9.

sophie: Draft to vendor: "Please confirm legal entity and tax residency. If Portuguese (PT123456780) please reissue without VAT and include 'IVA - autoliquida\u00e7\u00e3o / reverse charge' plus our EU VAT ID. If US entity, provide W-9 and reissue accordingly."

maria: Sent at 10:07. Vendor replied they'll reissue today. :thumbsup:

leo: Finance: keep payment hold for VAT portion only. If they reissue correctly, release net payment. If not, request credit note and escalate.

sophie: I'll verify the corrected invoice and sign off. If vendor insists on VAT citing simplified regime, ask them to provide legal citation; otherwise we insist on reissue.

maria: I'll upload the reissued invoice when received and ping @sophie. Closing loop until then.
